file_stem: RWB E1 041 Retention classes and virus scan on intake
title: Retention classes and virus scan on intake
goal: Block infected files before storage, and keep or archive each document by its retention class
why: An infected scan must never reach the store or OCR. Documents age out by policy class; nothing is deleted, REVIEW items go to Compliance.
triggers: scanNow() before every upload is stored
ace_note: No ACE read. Legal hold comes from the Workbench case (recovery_case.legal_hold).

writes.note: LEGAL10Y 120 m REVIEW, GENERAL05Y 60 m ARCHIVE

stores: Intake, quarantine, write-once and archive-tier blob containers; review list retention/review/{runDate}.csv; audit MALWARE_BLOCKED; scanning service

path.text: JOB-17: expiry by class, skip holds

rules: BR1: scan before store; an infected file is never stored
BR4: a legal hold stops archive and expiry
BR5: nothing is deleted; REVIEW items are listed for a decision
BR7: no decision log entry, no archive
risks: Scanner down -> item stays unscanned, upload 503 (MSG-P5-022)
Bad end action or 0 months in the load -> refused (MSG-P3-027)
example: eicar-0002.pdf from a branch scanner -> scan_result INFECTED
-> moved to quarantine, no document row, audit MALWARE_BLOCKED
Classes: LEGAL10Y 120 months REVIEW | GENERAL05Y 60 months ARCHIVE
